name: Back in stock
purpose: Tells people a sold-out item has returned.
trigger: someone asks to be told when a sold-out product returns

steps.event: the product is back in stock
steps.label: waits for the restock

steps.name: It's back
steps.job: Names the product and links straight to it.
steps.subject: Back in stock: the one you asked about

rules: Sent as a transactional message. They asked for it, so it reaches people who are not on the newsletter.
why: The highest-intent email in the set. They asked for this product by name.
watch: Transactional status needs the platform's approval and locks the email while approved. Plan edits between restocks.
